title: Register with the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commissioner to deliver funded aged care
what: An entity must be registered as a registered provider, in the registration categories for the services it delivers, before delivering funded aged care services.

sources.title: Aged Care Act 2024

sources.quote: To deliver funded aged care services, an entity must be registered as a registered provider by the Commissioner.
